script: On Mars, sunsets are blue. Fine Martian dust scatters blue light forward, so the sky around the setting Sun glows blue. During the day, the same dust turns the Martian sky a dusty butterscotch color. NASA rovers have photographed these blue sunsets many times. Here on Earth it is the opposite, with blue skies by day and red sunsets. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
